title: A blank Role name blocks Create with an inline message
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Create Role page.
custom_steps:
1. Leave Role name blank (or clear it after typing).
  2. Look at the Create button and the field.
custom_expected:
With Role name empty the Create button is disabled.

Touching then clearing the field shows 'Role name is a required field' under the label.
evidence: UI: with a blank Role Name the Create button is disabled; touching then clearing the name shows inline error "Role name is a required field".
